indian_entity: Indian ('Brahmin') prescription in the Tang imperial pharmacopoeia
chinese_source: Su Jing et al., Xinxiu Bencao (Newly Revised Materia Medica), imperial commission, 659
event: The Tang state pharmacopoeia records a 'Brahmin's prescription' as the known remedy for beriberi (jiaoqi), in all probability carried to China by an Indian Buddhist monk
firmness_reason: A dated imperial pharmacopoeia entry; the Indian provenance is stated in the record itself
notes: An Indian formula with official Chinese status by 659 — the transmission at the level of practice, a generation before Yijing's eyewitness account of the system behind it.
